cases.name: Christy Elizabeth Cowan
cases.narrative: On 5/28/1996, her body was found in a pond on the property where he was employed as a landscaper. She sustained blunt trauma to her jaw and chop wounds to the top of her head and behind her ear. Furthermore, Cowan had injuries consistent with manual strangulation. The medical examiner determined that Cowan died from the combination of strangulation and chop wounds.
